materialSetPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished wide visual design sheet for an ORIGINAL creature-collecting adventure game's upgradable EQUIPMENT CARDS. This is a Skill Card Master concept study, inspired by the bright friendly appeal of Pokemon equipment illustrations and Japanese monster-collecting JRPGs, but use an original device and original card layout, no franchise logos or existing characters. Landscape 3072x1536. Four large portrait cards stand in one evenly spaced horizontal row on an extremely quiet light ivory studio background. All four cards must depict EXACTLY THE SAME EQUIPMENT in exactly the same central pose, scale, orientation and silhouette, so only rarity materials and a final breakthrough emblem change. Equipment: a cute but precise portable epistemic focusing lens, ivory circular optical ring with dark teal glass, two small turquoise orbital nodes and a short navy grip, a coral-red calibration tab. It looks like an adventure research gadget, not jewelry or a human character. Three thin incoming source rays combine into one path while one independent contrasting ray stays separate. Hand-drawn clean dark-navy outlines, beautiful colorful cel shading, soft watercolor painted sky/grass accents, collectible illustration quality, not photorealistic. Keep the same base equipment design in EVERY card. Top of each card contains the SAME exact Chinese name '依赖镜头'. Top right has the rarity exactly: first 'C', second 'R', third 'SR', fourth 'SSR'. Bottom of every card only says 'SKILL EQUIPMENT'. No numerical attack/HP, no percentages, no star rank. First C: lovely matte printed illustration, simple navy and cream frame, NO GOLD, NO HOLOGRAM, NO rainbow sparkles. Second R: identical art and frame geometry with a SMALL local iridescent hologram only over the lens glass, everything else matte, NO gold frame, NO big sparkles. Third SR: SAME card layout and same device, refined gold foil hairline frame, textured gold embossing in the corner details, restrained holographic film over the picture window; title and text never glow or get obscured. Fourth SSR: SAME base card and equipment, gold foil frame maintained; a unique BROKEN-AND-RECONNECTED CIRCLE breakthrough medallion appears at the upper right of the picture, etched lines form a new two-part pattern around the SAME lens without changing its silhouette; very sparse sparkles and richer inner image depth, prestigious but legible, not a blinding glow. The SSR difference must be an identifiable new emblem and reorganized pattern, not only more shine. Under the four cards, small exact labels: 'MATTE', 'LOCAL HOLO', 'GOLD HOLO', 'BREAKTHROUGH'. At upper left of the whole sheet one small neat heading 'SKILL EQUIPMENT / MATERIAL STUDY'. Crisp balanced professional art-direction board, generous equal margins, no website UI, no extra cards, no text paragraphs, no watermark. The four cards should be clearly comparable finished concept card illustrations.

relatedPrompts.equipmentPage: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished desktop game-like application screen concept, landscape 1536x1024. The reference image is ART DIRECTION AND EQUIPMENT IDENTITY reference only, do not reproduce its four-card sheet layout. Preserve its exact friendly cel-shaded adventure illustration, ivory/navy/teal/coral colors and the round focusing-lens equipment with ivory ring, dark teal glass, two turquoise nodes, short dark grip, coral calibration tab. App: 'SKILL CARD MASTER'. A welcoming creature-collecting adventure equipment room for managing AI Agent characters and their Skill equipment. Rich game interface with a painted sky and field-research workshop visible through a window, ivory paper panels with disciplined navy keylines, tactile tab navigation, original illustrations. Not a conventional enterprise SaaS dashboard. Composition: restrained left navigation rail, main spacious central character inspection stage, a right equipment detail card, a bottom row of three genuinely beautiful equipped Skill cards showing C, R, SR material tiers from reference. Center character: an ORIGINAL small turquoise-and-cream owl-like field-researcher creature, two angular feather tufts, a coral explorer scarf, tiny navy satchel, standing confidently and holding the SAME focusing lens. Cute collectible RPG companion but not any existing Pokemon character. The original creature represents the AI AGENT, never the human user's personal level. No character level, no HP, no XP, no attack stats, no arbitrary ability scores. Headings in exact readable Chinese: main top '知识库与笔记治理'; near creature 'Agent · 档案员'; right section '已装备 Skill'; bottom section '本次卡组'. On right show one full SR card with exact name '依赖镜头' and clear SR badge, its foil and gold match reference; a small button label '查看方法'. Three ability tabs above bottom deck: '摄取', '蒸馏', '碰撞'. Navigation labels '场景', 'Agent', 'Skill 图鉴'. At the top right discreet exact label '视觉概念 · 演示配置'. Skill equip slots should visibly connect to the creature with 2 or 3 calm thin lines, not glowing cyber HUD. No locked SSR slot, no rarity-progress meter, no financial metrics, no rewards store. Readable functional hierarchy, crisp interface typography, strong artwork emphasis, the real concept is choosing an Agent and equipping relevant methods. The cards and surrounding page must feel from one coherent game world. No extra marketing copy, no watermark.
relatedPrompts.ssrStoryboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide three-frame ANIMATION STORYBOARD for an equipment-card SSR breakthrough reveal in a bright creature-collecting adventure art style. Use reference as exact card equipment and art direction reference. Landscape 3072x1536. The SAME '依赖镜头' Skill equipment card appears in all three equal large panels side by side, same scale and perspective, preserving the ivory ring, teal lens, two turquoise orbital nodes, short navy grip, coral tab and reference card frame layout. No character, this is the SKILL EQUIPMENT's permanent breakthrough. Quiet ivory sheet, dark navy text, precise panel arrangement. Label the three frames only with exact Chinese: '01 旧结构打开', '02 新关系成形', '03 突破留存'. First frame: an existing SR gold-framed card standing in its normal bright illustrated adventure setting; a thin closed etched ring in front of the card separates gently into two arcs, illumination recedes to the lens, no shattering glass or destructive explosion. Second frame: arcs calmly rearrange around two distinct ray paths, one path handled by a soft contextual lens, the other through a clear mechanical frame; deliberate precise new connections, the card remains readable, restrained teal-and-warm-gold light flows inward. Third frame: final SSR card in the identical pose, a clearly recognizable newly connected OPEN CIRCLE medallion at upper right of the art window, 'SSR' at card top right, warm foil border and very sparse sparks settling; card title '依赖镜头'. Show a permanent emblem that remains after light settles, not a full-screen flash. Under the third frame one small exact sentence: '共同信念进 Prompt，高代价不变量进机械门禁。' Each frame should be a premium finished game card illustration, but all three visibly same item. Material progression and geometry transformation tell the story; no lottery, no drop chance, no XP, no character evolution, no card multiplication, no grand explosion, no purple neon, no watermark. Limited palette and cel-painted art exactly consistent with reference.
